entities.summary: Kepler-11g is an exoplanet discovered in the orbit of the sunlike star Kepler-11 by the Kepler space telescope, a NASA satellite tasked with searching for terrestrial planets. Kepler-11g is the outermost of the star's six planets. The planet orbits at a distance of nearly half the mean distance between Earth and the Sun.
